inputs_sent.prompt: A woman sits at her desk in a bright office by day, on a video call, seen by her laptop's webcam. She listens to a colleague giving an update: she looks at her screen just below the lens with a calm, interested face and blinks naturally. She gives a small nod, raises her eyebrows a little with interest, and once glances down at her notes and back up. Her lips stay closed: she does not speak at any time. Small natural movements only, like a real person listening on a video call. Her hands stay out of the picture. Nobody enters the picture and nobody walks past behind her. The camera is a fixed laptop webcam: the framing does not change at all. At the end she is back in the same pose as at the start, looking at her screen. One continuous shot with no cuts, no zoom, no pan, no music, no subtitles and no text.
